shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), climb animations, wall risers, research-gated links, Perspective Shift + Toggleable Overlays support, and global click-through so open air is never a click target. Windows 12+13 are SHIPPED. Window 14 is building Combat Extended compat for manned weapons.

Keep every ⚠. # As above, So below II (V2) > **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE. DATED SOURCE BACKUPS LIVE AT `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). `Source/` only - no Defs, no Textures. **When a V2 feature has a V1 ancestor, READ THE V1 FILE FIRST.** Confirmed useful: `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs` (§78d). START HERE **CURRENT PHASE: WINDOW 14, BUILD MODE. §88 (CE MANNED WEAPONS) IS THE ACTIVE WORK.** **✅ WINDOWS 12 + 13 ARE SHIPPED** to Workshop 3776015553 on 2026-08-29. Pushed as **`b182988`** ("shipped"), content commit **`6485daf`**. Change notes are `docs/UPDATE_NOTES.txt`. **⚠ THE WORKSPACE DLL IS CURRENTLY A *RELEASE* BUILD - THE UNUSUAL STATE.** It matches what shipped (verified by decompiling `ABV2Debug.LogTransit == false`). **The next `build_mod` silently reverts it to Debug**, which is correct for testing and turns §85.16's transit tracing back on.   • /

(3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES. **What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity. **⚠⚠ THE SEVENTY-ONE RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX - **and its publish-time twin: A BUILD MESSAGE IS NOT PROOF THE RIGHT THING WAS BUILT; decompile the binary.** 18 (§57a): **NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE** - grep version at rule 54. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE - selectable is drawable, and so is **highlightable** (§83). 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW - and §84.8's other half. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** 47 (§79): **A FOREIGN MOD'S CACHED CURSOR CELL IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT COORDINATE SPACE.** 48 (§81a): **A WRITE THAT IS READ BACK BY ITS OWN CALLER IS NOT A WRITE.** 49 (§0c): **A TEST THAT PROVES FEATURE A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT FEATURE B.** 50 (§82a): **TWO OF OUR OWN PATCHES ON ONE VANILLA METHOD CANCEL SILENTLY.** GREP OUR OWN `[HarmonyPatch]` LIST FIRST. 51 (§82b): **A FACTORY HAS USUALLY CONSUMED ITS INPUT BY THE TIME THE POSTFIX RUNS.** 52 (§83a): **AN OVERLAY MUST ASK THE SAME QUESTION THE CLICK WILL ASK, AND IT MUST NOT BE A QUESTION THAT WRITES.** 53 (§83c): **A PREDICATE PASSED IN IS CLOSED OVER THE ARGUMENTS THE CALLER ALREADY HAS.** 54 (§84a): **A CLEAN GREP IS NOT AN ABSENCE - SEARCH FOR THE CAPABILITY, NOT THE TYPE NAME.** 55 (§84.3): **"AFTER THE DUTY HAD ITS TURN" INCLUDES A FALLBACK JOB YOU WOULD NEVER CALL A REAL ONE.** 56 (§84.5): **WHEN YOU RANK CANDIDATES BY ONE COST AND FILTER THEM BY ANOTHER, THE RANKING FINDS THE FILTER'S BLIND SPOT.** 57 (§85a): **WHEN TWO SUBSYSTEMS EACH ANSWER "WHICH SIDE OF THIS THING", ONE OF THEM IS ABOUT TO BE WRONG.** 58 (§85b): **A PROPERTY OF THE ART CANNOT BE DERIVED FROM THE DEF.** 59 (§85.8): **`size` MUST BE MEASURED FROM THE DRAWING, NOT COPIED FROM `drawSize`.** 60 (§85.9): **MEASURE THE PIXELS; A DRAW OFFSET AND AN ART-OFFSET TABLE ARE THE SAME NUMBER TWICE.** 61 (§85c): **A COLOURED VERSION OF A GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT, AND VANILLA HARD-CODES ITS TYPE.** 62 (§85d): **A TABLE OF FINISHED ANSWERS ROTS; STORE ONLY WHAT NOTHING ELSE OWNS AND DERIVE THE REST.** 63 (§85.14): **MEASURE A PATIENCE FROM THE EVENT IT NAMES.** 64 (§85.16): **A DIAGNOSTIC THAT IS OFF BY DEFAULT IS A DIAGNOSTIC THAT DOES NOT EXIST.** 65 (§85.17): **WHEN A DERIVED RULE IS RIGHT THREE TIMES OUT OF FOUR, THE FOURTH IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT.** 66 (§85.19): **A DESTINATION CELL DOES NOT CONSTRAIN THE SIDE IT IS ENTERED FROM.** 67 (§85.20): **AN EARLY RETURN THAT PRESERVES STATE MUST ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER.** 68 (§85.22): **WHEN THE SAME 'EXCEPTION' IS REPORTED TWICE ON ONE DEF, IT IS THE DEF'S RULE, NOT TWO EXCEPTIONS.** 69 (§86a): **WHEN YOU SUSPEND A FOREIGN MOD'S DRIVER, YOU INHERIT EVERY REQUEST THAT DRIVER SERVED.** A UI control can be nothing but a cleared field whose only consumer is the loop you switched off. Enumerate what READS the state you neutralised, not just what writes it. 70 (§87a): **AN OPT-IN CORRECTION APPLIED AT N CONSUMERS IS A DEFAULT APPLIED AT THE WRONG LAYER.** Correct it at the source and enumerate the EXCEPTIONS - that list is finite, auditable and self-reporting; the consumer list grows silently forever. 71 (§89): **A PROBE THAT ASKS FOR "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK.** `GetFirstPawn` + "is it me?" reports `none` for the one arrangement that matters. When a diagnostic exonerates a cell, check whether it COUNTED or merely peeked. --- # WINDOW 14 LEDGER (open) 1. **§88 CE MANNED WEAPONS - ACTIVE WORK.** Plan and findings in §88. 2. **⚠⚠ THE WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST.** Subscribe to 3776015553, load THAT copy. Still never done. 3. **§89 STACKED-PAWN STALL - INSTRUMENTED, NOT FIXED.** The next occurrence self-diagnoses; `pawnsHere` naming a `TRANSIT` co-occupant makes it ours. 4. **⚠ §85 SHIPPED-UNVERIFIED:** the flipped up-link `approachCells` and §85.23's float-menu verbs went out untested. Watch for reports. 5. **⚠ `CarveLanding` leaves the front tile unstandable inside fresh pockets** (3 sightings). 6. **⚠ §83 SCOPE GAPS (rule 49):** AoE circle, **turret ring from another band (also §88 PART 4)**, truncation cap. 7. **⚠ §84 SCOPE GAPS (rule 49):** PART A (mech giver repair), PART C (escape clamp). 8. **⚠ OTHER ABILITY GIVERS UNAUDITED (rule 54):** `JobGiver_AISkipToJobTarget`, `JobGiver_AIAbilityFight`, `JobGiver_AICastAbility`, `JobGiver_AICastAbilityOnSelf`. 9. **⚠ TOGGLEABLE OVERLAYS NOT RE-TESTED SINCE §78,** and §87 now moves the mouse itself. §79.1 reads TO's cached cursor from their own ray so it should be untouched - UNVERIFIED. (PS *was* re-verified in #395.) 10. **§87 FOLLOW-UP:** `MultiPawnGotoController.ProcessInputEvents` is suppressed to preserve §33f; letting `end` descend is probably an improvement, deliberately untried. 11. **§78 FOLLOW-ONS:** delete retired ghost stubs; AnimationDef pipeline port (OFFERED, NOT ACCEPTED); hostiles skipping the hold. 12. **⚠ FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT.** RimIOT and Eccentric Tech never decompiled. Rule 18. 13. **§62.N formal line. §70 field verify (§70.B OPEN). §71 upstream report. §75/§76/§79.4/§80.4 residue. §82/§83/§84.10/§85.7 residue. §77 mockup D. §64; §65; §61; §60/59/58/55/54/53; §56.1; DATA network thin; DCH `Hosts` row.** **⚠ TEST-LOOP NOTES:** palette pins resolve during map init - use the Debug Actions MENU for `PlayingOnMap` actions. **PS runs and the §81 dialog need `quicktest=false`, and PS must be passed as `companionMods: ["ferny.PerspectiveShift"]` in an isolated run or it will not load.** **A CE run needs CE + its dependency chain the same way, or `isolated:false`.** **Startup warnings never reach the bridge.** **`build_mod` builds DEBUG** (so `LogTransit` is ON). **⚠ CHECK `Mod_50b4332c2547_ABMod.xml` IN THE TEST SAVEDATA BEFORE A BANDED RUN** (absent `multiLevel` = TRUE). **⚠ SKY BANDS ARE THE CHEAPEST SEE-THROUGH TEST RIG**; the INVERSE rig is how upward gets tested. **⚠ `AB2: place stairs down here` SPAWNS AT Rot4.North.** **⚠⚠ `Log.Message` NEVER REACHES THE BRIDGE, BUT `Player.log` IS READABLE FROM HERE** - `C:\Users\Astryl\AppData\LocalLow\Ludeon Studios\RimWorld by Ludeon Studios\Player.log`, and it does NOT move for an isolated savedata run. **⚠ ART IS MEASURABLE FROM HERE: `Tools/MeasureSprites.ps1`.** ⚠ Long `newText` blocks in the edit tool have truncated mid-string SIX times; write a temp file INSIDE THE MOD FOLDER and splice with python. **⚠ KNOWN-BENIGN FOREIGN NOISE:** VFEM2 TorchWallLamp MakeThing error; Rimefeller `discord.dds` `f2fab05fc732a605`; Rimefeller `CompOilDerrick.setfull` NRE (`#fc35ef297211de6b`). NONE ARE OURS. --- # 1-30 — unchanged. # 31 PUBLISHING — `docs/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md` IS AUTHORITATIVE Strip = SIX moves (`Source/`, `Tools/`, `docs/`, `.git/`, `mockups/`, `.gitignore`) to a staging dir OUTSIDE `Mods/`; the utility pushes FILES + PREVIEW ONLY, so change notes and description go into the Steam **web** editor by hand. Commit and push BEFORE the strip. **⚠ `.gitignore` travels with `.git/`.** Proven window-13 run: release build → **decompile to prove it IS Release** → log-hygiene grep → metadata check → write `UPDATE_NOTES.txt` and grep it for em-dashes (house rule) → commit and push → strip with a loop that PRINTS each move and says ABSENT for anything missing → contraband `find` (`obj`/`bin`/`*.pdb`/`*.csproj`/`*.cs`/`0Harmony.dll`) → **confirm `LoadFolders.xml` survived** → publish → restore with the same loop → rebuild to prove the restore lost nothing → commit "shipped". Record the staging path in §0 while stripped. # 32-87 — unchanged (see the index line at the top). §86 and §87 SHIPPED, both field-verified #395. # 88. COMBAT EXTENDED — MANNED WEAPONS ("STATIONARY MACHINE GUNS") — **WINDOW 14, IN PROGRESS** User picked the MANNED case specifically (a pawn operating a stationary gun), not CE turrets in general. **88.1 WHAT ALREADY WORKS.** The four §44 seams key on `Verb_LaunchProjectileCE`, `ShiftVecReport`, `ShiftTarget` and `ProjectileCE.Launch`, all of which a manned CE gun uses - shot legality, aim space, projectile origin and the high-ground suppression model are already band-aware for it. **⚠⚠ 88a WHAT DOES NOT, FROM DECOMPILING `CombatExtended.Building_TurretGunCE`.** It derives from `Building_Turret`, NOT `Building_TurretGun`, so `Patch_BuildingTurretGun_ABBandLocalForcedTarget` never runs on it. And `CanSetForcedTarget => mannableComp != null && PlayerControlled` - **in CE, force-targeting exists ONLY on MANNABLE turrets**, so the forced-target path IS the manned-gun path, which is what makes PART 1 the whole user-facing feature rather than a detail. Its `OrderAttack` does the raw `(targ.Cell - Position).LengthHorizontal` against `minRange` and `range`: §1's slicing rule, wrong in both directions across bands. **88.2 THE PLAN.** - **PART 1 (essential): `Building_TurretGunCE.OrderAttack`.** House pattern: a reflection-only, `Prepare()`-shape-validated prefix handling ONLY the cross-band case - re-run the two limits band-locally via `ABCombatV2.TrySolve`, then replicate CE's short tail (`forcedTarget = targ`, `TryStartShootSomething(false)`, the holdFire message). Same-band orders fall through to CE untouched. ⚠ REJECTED: a transpiler (fragile to write blind); and translating `targ` for the duration of CE's own body (CE sets `currentTargetInt` inside it, so the gun would fire at the translated cell for a tick). - **PART 2: `CompFireArc.WithinFireArc`** - both `OrderAttack` and `IsValidTarget` gate on it and the angle is raw geometry. Only defs carrying the comp. - **PART 3: acquisition - VERIFY, DON'T ASSUME (rule 54).** `TargSearcher()` returns the MANNING PAWN when manned; a non-`NonSnap` gun then goes through vanilla `AttackTargetFinder.BestShootTargetFromCurrentPosition`, which our §42 postfix covers. Believed fine, unproven. ⚠ A def carrying `NonSnapTurretExtension` uses CE's own `NonSnapAttackTargetFinder` and is NOT covered. - **PART 4: `DrawRangeRings`** - `GenDraw.DrawRadiusRing(Position, range)`, i.e. §83.7's "turret ring from another band" gap, now with an owner. **⚠ 88.3 TESTING IS THE EXPENSIVE PART.** Needs `isolated:false` or a `companionMods` launch with CE and its dependency chain - heavier and noisier than any window-12/13 test. CE is installed at load order 38, packageId `CETeam.CombatExtended`. # 89. THE STACKED-PAWN STALL — **DIAGNOSED, INSTRUMENTED, NOT FIXED** Five sightings across four runs (Rogue x2, Rynyk, Hunin, Jay). Signature always identical: `moving=True`, `path=FOUND`, `CanReach=True`, destination stable, **not advancing**. First four `GotoWander`; #395's was a player-ordered `Goto`, which rules out anything wander-specific. **⚠⚠ 89a THE TELL, AND OUR PROBE WAS BLIND TO IT (rule 71).** #395 logged `Jay at (63,0,458) ... nextCell=(63,0,458) ... occupant=none`. **The pather's next cell is the cell the pawn already stands on.** The old probe did `next.GetFirstPawn(map)` then discarded the answer when it was the watched pawn - so for TWO PAWNS ON ONE CELL it printed `none`, and the report read "nothing is in the way" while the pawn was in its own way. **THE VANILLA MECHANISM IS AN INFINITE EARLY RETURN.** `Pawn_PathFollower.PatherTick` opens with `if (WillCollideWithPawnAt(pawn.Position, forceOnlyStanding: true, useId: true))`; it tries `CellFinder.TryFindBestPawnStandCell`, and on failure stamps `failedToFindCloseUnoccupiedCellTicks`, after which `FailedToFindCloseUnoccupiedCellRecently()` (a 100-tick window) makes PatherTick **return before any movement code** every tick. `moving` stays true, the path stays found, `nextCell` never leaves `Position`. **INSTRUMENTED IN WINDOW 13, NOT FIXED.** `ABStuckWatchdog` now (a) COUNTS every pawn on the cell, self included and labelled, each tagged moving/idle and **`TRANSIT`** if `ABWormholePather.HasPending`; (b) invokes vanilla's own `WillCollideWithPawnAt` by reflection rather than reimplementing it - **the `useId` tie-break decides WHICH of two co-located pawns yields, and guessing it wrong inverts the answer on exactly this case**; (c) reads `failedToFindCloseUnoccupiedCellTicks` with vanilla's 100-tick window copied verbatim; (d) emits a `SELF-STACK` verdict ahead of `BLOCKED`; (e) warns once (rule 33) if either private member fails to bind, because a silent degrade returns the exact wording that hid this for five sightings. **⚠ IS IT OURS? THE NEXT OCCURRENCE ANSWERS IT.** A co-occupant tagged `TRANSIT` makes it ours - §78's hold parks a crossing pawn with `StopDead()` for 90 ticks and §85.19 queues pawns onto the approach tile, both deliberate ways to co-locate pawns near a stairwell. Anything else is ordinary vanilla traffic. Rule 18: do not convict on the hypothesis.
